Volt Rush delves into the pressing transition from an oil-driven economy to one increasingly dependent on metals and rare earths. This compelling narrative sheds light on the critical role these resources play in the development of modern technology, particularly in electric vehicles and renewable energy sectors.

The Plot

Congo and Chile, alongside the bustling battery factories in China. This vivid depiction not only highlights the geographical diversity of resource extraction but also underscores the complex interplay of politics, economics, and environmental concerns.

Themes

Central to Volt Rush is the examination of the new resource race and its key players. The author profiles influential figures, including billionaires and commodity traders, revealing the motivations and strategies that drive their actions in this high-stakes arena.
